name: "BB" Bad Brotherhood
caption: Announced its own relaunch, from the ashes of the Destruction Inc. Army, during a guest star's entrance on FJPW's own first full show.
notes: Announced as a small, deliberately exclusive successor to the Destruction Inc. Army, itself never structured here (a purely retrospective, in-promo reference, not itself an FJPW roster act). Ezon and Radon appear in the same angle but are not named among the Bad Brotherhood's own stated membership.

tenures.role: stable — relaunched by announcement during a guest appearance
tenures.source: FJPW Saturday Night CHAOS #1, Part I (2 November 1997).
